measures.id: Eaton County Transportation Authority (EATRAN) Millage Renewal and Restoration Authorization Question
measures.title: EATRAN Millage Renewal and Restoration
measures.summary: Would renew Eaton County's public transportation tax at 0.2493 mill and restore 0.0007 mill lost to rollbacks, for a total of up to 0.25 mill ($0.25 per $1,000 of taxable value) for 2027 through 2031. The money is for public transportation by the Eaton County Transportation Authority (EATRAN), including service for elderly and disabled riders. The 2027 levy is estimated to raise about $1,309,743, of which about $24,754 may go to local development and brownfield authorities.
measures.yesMeans: Eaton County could levy up to 0.25 mill for EATRAN public transportation for 2027 through 2031.
measures.noMeans: The EATRAN millage would not be renewed and restored for 2027 through 2031.

measures.id: Local Roads and Streets Preservation and Improvement Millage Proposal
measures.title: Local Roads and Streets Preservation and Improvement Millage
measures.summary: Would authorize Eaton County to levy a new property tax of up to 1.5 mills ($1.50 per $1,000 of taxable value) for 2026 through 2035. The money would pay for preservation, maintenance, drainage, culvert and bridge repairs and other improvements to paved and gravel county local roads in the townships, including dust control twice a year on gravel roads, and for improving city and village streets. The 2026 levy is estimated to raise $7,843,350, shared among the Eaton County Road Commission and the county's cities and villages, with about $151,612 possibly going to local development and brownfield authorities.
measures.yesMeans: Eaton County could levy up to 1.5 mills for local roads and city and village streets for 2026 through 2035.
measures.noMeans: The new roads and streets millage would not be levied.
